Game Overview

In Gluttonous Giraffe, the core idea is straightforward: guide your giraffe through a vibrant maze, devouring everything in sight to stretch its neck to incredible lengths. With strategic thinking and quick reflexes, tackle ever-changing levels in a delightful twist on classic snake gameplay. Enjoy intuitive controls and charming graphics in this endlessly entertaining arcade adventure.
